Subject: Order form field affinity, portal registration constraints and MSA redline question

Hi Alicia / ClearView procurement team —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to start the portal registration and activation steps but ran into two items that need quick alignment before we submit the vendor onboarding bundle to Ariba:

1) Conditional PO acknowledgement window — your portal is enforcing a PO-ACK within 5 business days for electronic orders. Our standard Order Form (see attached draft) uses a 10 business day acknowledgment window; legal asked us to confirm if you can accept 10 days or if we should submit an exception/msa redline.

2) Field affinity / CSV mapping — your portal expects a field labeled "PO_LINE_IDENTIFIER" (alphanumeric, 18 chars) while our ERP exports "PO_LINE_ID" (numeric). To avoid failed imports we prepared a proposed mapping CSV (attached) and a brief note in the draft order form clarifying acceptable formats. Can you confirm your ingestion can accept the alternate header or if you'll need us to reformat outbound POs?

Attachments: ClearView_FieldMapping_PROPOSED.csv, ClearView_OrderForm_DRAFT.pdf, ClearView_Portal_Spec_v3.pdf

If these are acceptable, we'll:
- ask Legal to finalize the minimal redline to the Order Form (Kimberly, see callout below)
- request portal admin access and provisioning from your team
- submit the onboarding bundle to Ariba for activation

Kimberly / Markus / Logan — can you weigh in on the PO-ACK window and whether we can accept 10 business days (we prefer not to open an SLA exception)?

Next step: Alicia, if you can confirm the mapping header flexibility and preferred contact to provision portal credentials, we'll queue the registration.

Thanks,
Marissa

Marissa, thanks for the clear summary. A few quick notes:  

- PO-ACK window: We typically require 5 business days for automated PO acknowledge to keep downstream fulfillment in sync. That said, we have accepted 10 business days for some enterprise partners when there are legal constraints. Please have your legal redline the Order Form language to 10 days and we'll escalate to our procurement governance board for approval.

- Field mapping: Our ingestion can accept an alternate header if it is included in the vendor upload template. The portal admin will map vendor headers to our canonical fields during onboarding. Attached is our latest portal spec; we'll also ask ops to expose a field alias for "PO_LINE_ID".

I copied our procurement mailbox. For provisioning, contact: procurement@clearviewhealth.com. We'll need a vendor contact name, taxonomy (SIC/NAICS), and a W-9 (or equivalent).

I attached ClearView_Portal_Spec_v3.pdf for reference.

Best,
Alicia
